# GC8613 register values as the YIZHAN 4K camera's stock sensor driver (gc8613_MIPI.ko) programs them, read from that
# module of the camera's flash: facts about the sensor's configuration, in our own form, under this driver's licence.
# Format: `[section]`, then one write a line, register and value in hex; `pause MS` waits.

# The 3840x2160 readout at 30 fps: MCLK 24 MHz, 4 lanes, wpclk 216 MHz (HTS 800 = 14.8 us line), VTS 2250.
